- The Agents help legend now documents both colors: running (amber) and finished (grey).
- Outcome still lives on the rest of the row (status word, exit/timeout/stalled/follow-up badges). The gear is lifecycle only.

- No feature flag.
- No render-cache key change (`monitor_state` and `stop_time` were already in the key; a regression test pins that).
